howItWorks.title: How to Use this Map
howItWorks.subtitle: Get store addresses, links to websites and main info about the products
howItWorks.description: Our mission is to make it easy to find Ukrainian-made products across Canada, from traditional foods to modern goods.
howItWorks.card1.title: FIND STORES ON THE MAP
howItWorks.card1.desc: Locate curated retailers by region, province, or product category. Access verified addresses, direct mapping links, and essential store data in one streamlined, high-definition interface.
howItWorks.card2.title: ADD NEW LOCATIONS
howItWorks.card2.desc: Strengthen the network by pinning new locations. Found a local favorite carrying Ukrainian goods? Help the community grow by contributing new data and supporting local commerce.
howItWorks.card3.title: SHARE THE MAP
howItWorks.card3.desc: Enable others to shop with purpose. Amplify the movement by helping allies and the diaspora find, support, and sustain the global reach of Ukrainian craftsmanship.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: BuyUkrainian.ca is a community-driven map that helps people find Ukrainian-made products sold across Canada. We connect the community with local businesses and authentic products from home.
faq.q2: How can I add a store?
faq.a2: Select the "Add a store" button, fill in the details including name, products, and address. Your store will be reviewed by the community before appearing on the map.
faq.a3: Additions are reviewed by the community to keep the map accurate and useful.
faq.a4: Currently, you can contact us to update information. We're working on a feature to allow community edits in the future.
faq.a5: Yes. BuyUkrainian.ca is free to use. We're a community project dedicated to supporting Ukrainian businesses in Canada.

about.title: About BuyUkrainian.ca
about.subtitle: Connecting Ukrainians across Canada with authentic products from home
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.text: BuyUkrainian.ca was created to help people in Canada find and support businesses selling authentic Ukrainian-made products. Whether you're looking for traditional foods or other products from home, our community-driven map makes it easy to find what you need.
about.how.title: How it works
about.how.text: Anyone can add a store selling Ukrainian-made products. The community reviews each addition for accuracy. Once approved, the store appears on the map for everyone to find.
about.community.title: Community driven
about.community.text: This project is built by and for the community. We rely on contributions from people like you to grow the map. Every store help fellow Ukrainians find a piece of home.
about.contributeText: Help grow the map by adding stores you know about.
